display_long_description:
**Turn your room into a fantasy battlefield.**

**RealityGuard is a co-op mixed reality defense game where your real space becomes part of the fight.** Build magical towers on real furniture, shape enemy paths around your room, cast spells with your own hands, and defend your home from waves of fantasy invaders.

**Play solo, team up online, fight side by side in local co-op, or challenge other players in PVP mode.** You are not just watching towers do the work. Freeze enemies, trigger special tower weapons, and jump into the action when your defenses are about to fall.

[media]

- **Defend Your Real Room**

Turn tables, sofas, floors, and walls into the battlefield.

[media]

- **Online & Local Co-op**

Build, shoot, cast, and survive with friends online or in the same physical space.

- **Cast Spells and Fight Back**

Freeze enemies, blast waves, trigger traps, and fight directly.

[media]


- **Build Powerful Defenses**

Unlock towers, cards, upgrades, and abilities to create new strategies.

- **Challenge and Endless Modes**

Take on story levels, events, weather, traps, combat bonuses, and endless waves. Climb the global leaderboards and earn rewards.


RealityGuard is in Early Access. Join our Discord to share feedback and help shape the game.

Website: https://www.realityguardar.com

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/jNmnz9PdVW

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@RealityGuard_Official

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@realityguard
